source.provenance: Fan-made: its players' abilities are Cam F's, not Sports Interactive's. Against SI's own CM 93/94 data (ben-clarke/championship-manager-93-tools' export) for 1,452 English-league players matched by name they correlate 0.72, 74 are equal, and Cam F's run 19 lower on average. It keeps CM 01/02's league sizes, not 1993/94's: its Premier Division has 20 clubs (Oldham Athletic and Swindon Town, of the real 22, are in its First Division) and its French First Division 18 (Angers and Martigues are in its Second), against 1993-94 FA Premier League and 1993-94 French Division 1 on Wikipedia (revisions 1371793527 and 1366136574).
